subject.title: Replacement for accidentally closed #3102: ClawScan backend error persists despite clean VirusTotal

question: After inspecting the two production jobs, is it safe to requeue or backfill the clean result for this exact artifact, or must the artifact remain in an error state pending deeper scanner diagnostics?
rationale: Writing an artifact security verdict is a protected production action; repository evidence cannot establish that the upstream result, job ownership, and persisted state are sufficiently consistent for a manual writeback.

options.title: Inspect then recover
options.body: Verify the artifact hash, provider result, and both job states, then requeue or backfill only if they form one consistent clean scan lineage.

options.title: Hold for worker diagnosis
options.body: Leave the artifact in error while collecting provider-polling, worker, and writeback diagnostics if the job records are inconsistent or incomplete.

recommendation.title: Inspect then recover
recommendation.body: Verify the artifact hash, provider result, and both job states, then requeue or backfill only if they form one consistent clean scan lineage.

likelyOwner.reason: Their earlier VirusTotal pipeline work and explicit routing in this issue make them the strongest available owner for the production safety decision.
